description: Terminal-Bench style sysadmin inventory: count /sbin/nologin accounts in etc/passwd, list their deduplicated sorted primary groups from etc/group, and find the files under srv/ with mode exactly 0750; the gate re-derives all three from the tree. Note: chmod is not in the default --auto-approve set (this task needs no chmod, it is a read-only inventory).

criteria: nologin_count counts only /sbin/nologin shells, groups_with_nologin is the deduplicated sorted primary-group list and files_group_only lists exactly the srv files with mode 0750; passwd, group, the srv tree and the gate are untouched.
